units.source_text: 村里的女招待中，唯独阿笑特别有伤风化——这是村里有权势的人早已有的一致看法。

en.t: Among the waitresses in the village, only Asho was considered especially immoral; this had long been the unanimous view of the village's influential people.

units.source_text: 派出所的警察忠实地秉承了他们的旨意，多次勒令她离开这个村庄。

en.t: The police at the local station faithfully carried out their wishes and repeatedly ordered her to leave the village.

units.source_text: 事情发生在一个月之前。

en.t: This had happened a month earlier.

units.source_text: 他们在宴席上为自己儿子不端的行为气愤到了极点。

en.t: At the banquet, they were furious over their own son's improper behavior.

units.source_text: 结果，她被警察送到镇上去了。

en.t: As a result, the police sent her off to town.

units.source_text: 因为阿笑这个天生的女招待，比娼妇还要放荡。

en.t: For Asho, a born waitress, was even more dissolute than a prostitute.
